coder_notes: Pan-cancer paediatric/young adult (<12 y Phase 1, 12-25 y Phase 2) trial. Glioblastoma appears only in the keywords; the conditions, title, inclusion criteria and arm label name only 'primary CNS tumors', so under C7/D27B glioblastoma is not named and the population is coded not_glioblastoma. If an adjudicator accepts keywords, it would be basket_gbm_eligible. ALK is named in the title/summary but the eligibility criteria list ROS1 and NTRK (current amendment ROS1 only for cohort 3).
